article.title: 完型 · 不要让体重秤绑架健身目标
article.context: 作者以自己的健身经历说明：过于频繁称重会让注意力从整体健康转向体重数字，改为每两周称重后，训练目标、营养判断和心理状态都更稳定。语气应亲切、务实，像有经验的人在分享可执行的健身建议。
rows: Weighing yourself regularly is a wonderful way to stay aware of any significant weight fluctuations.
定期称体重，是了解自己是否出现显著体重波动的好方法。
advance
However, when done too often, this habit can sometimes hurt more than it helps.
然而，一旦称得过于频繁，这个习惯有时反而会弊大于利。
contrast
As for me, weighing myself every day caused me to shift my focus from being generally healthy and physically active, to focusing solely on the scale.
就我而言，每天称重使我的注意力从保持整体健康、积极活动，转移到了只盯着体重秤上的数字。
story
That was bad to my overall fitness goals.
这对我的整体健身目标并没有好处。
conclude
I had gained weight in the form of muscle mass, but thinking only of lowering the number on the scale, I altered my training program.
我增加的其实是肌肉重量，可因为一心只想着把体重秤上的数字降下来，我还是改变了训练计划。
contrast
That conflicted with how I needed to train to reach my goals.
这与我为了实现目标本来应该采用的训练方式发生了冲突。
conclude
I also found that weighing myself daily did not provide an accurate depiction of the hard work and progress I was making in the gym.
我还发现，每天称重并不能准确反映我在健身房付出的努力和取得的进步。
explain
It takes about three weeks to a month to notice significant changes in your weight due to altering your training program.
改变训练计划后，大约要三周到一个月，体重才会出现明显变化。
explain
The most immediate changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost.
最先显现出来的变化，往往是在动作水平、力量以及身体围度的缩减上。
emphasize
For these reasons, I stopped weighing myself every day and switched to a bimonthly weighing schedule instead.
基于这些原因，我不再每天称重，而是改为每两周称一次。
action_turn
Since weight loss is not my goal, it is less important for me to track my weight each week.
既然减重并不是我的目标，我也就没必要每周追踪体重。
qualify
Weighing every other week allows me to observe and account for any significant weight changes.
每隔一周称一次，既能让我观察到明显的体重变化，也有时间判断这些变化是怎么来的。
explain
That tells me whether I need to adjust my training program.
这样我就能知道是否需要调整训练计划。
conclude
I use my bimonthly weigh-in results to get information about my nutrition as well.
我也会利用每两周一次的称重结果来了解自己的营养状况。
advance
If my training intensity remains the same, but I'm constantly hungry and dropping weight, this is a sign that I need to increase my daily caloric intake.
如果训练强度没有变化，我却总觉得饿、体重还在下降，那就说明我需要提高每天的热量摄入。
explain
The decision to stop weighing myself every day has done wonders for my overall health, fitness and well-being.
停止每天称重这一决定，让我的整体健康、健身状态和幸福感都大为改善。
emphasize
I'm experiencing increased zeal for working out since I no longer carry the burden of a disappointing morning weigh-in.
自从不再背负“早晨一称体重就失望”的心理负担后，我训练时反而更有热情了。
explain
I've also experienced greater success in achieving my specific fitness goals, because I'm training according to those goals, not the numbers on a scale.
我在实现具体健身目标方面也更成功了，因为现在我的训练依据是目标本身，而不是体重秤上的数字。
conclude
Rather than obsessing over the scale, turn your focus to how you look, feel, how your clothes fit and your overall energy level.
与其执着于体重秤，不如把注意力放在自己的外形和感受、衣服是否合身，以及整体精力状态上。
encourage
